inventory.detail: Existing GA4 recovery truth helper and consent-gated tracker are reused.

ga4Findings.detail: GA4 has explicit statuses and no unknown state.
GA4 client tracker is gated by NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID; current App Hosting source does not expose that public key.
GA4 client tracker respects analytics consent.
GA4 server evidence is configured in source through GA_PROPERTY_ID and the Data API dependency.

posthogFindings.detail: PostHog has explicit status and no unknown state.
PostHog provider is source-gated and current App Hosting source does not configure PostHog.

adminEvidenceFindings.detail: Missing external analytics is unavailable evidence, not zero traffic.
External analytics cannot override first-party event facts and rollups.
GA Data API calls remain blocked on default admin analytics load.

docsFindings.detail: Docs keep GA4 as evidence/export, not product truth.
Docs do not claim unsupported live GA4 product truth.

fixesApplied.detail: Added external analytics truth unit coverage.

prCleanupActions: No open GA4, PostHog, or external analytics truth PRs were present at start.
nextFixOrder: If client GA4 evidence is owner-approved, add NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID in deployment config in a dedicated config pass.
Keep GA Data API evidence behind explicit refresh and TTL; do not call it from default admin loads.
If PostHog evidence is owner-approved, configure NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY and keep consent gating intact.
